ns2:course.label: Advanced Grammar
ns2:course.description: Study of the structure of modern Italian in both its phonological and syntactic aspects for the student who already has a functional command of the language, with an emphasis on developing ability to analyze and interpret grammatical structures. Prerequisite: ITAL 210 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ITAL 210 or consent of instructor.
